title: Enterprise Architecture
description: An advanced IT course on aligning systems with business strategy—covering EA frameworks, business/information/application/technology architecture, IT governance, SOA, cloud, security, roadmaps, change management, and a portfolio-ready enterprise architecture capstone.

topics.description: Frame enterprise architecture as the discipline that connects business strategy, operating model, information, applications, technology, governance, and change.

children.title: Cost, resilience, scalability, and faster change
